propositions: A ticket declaring no repository edits (file_impact_scope none) should keep its certified plan valid after an unrelated commit moves HEAD, instead of falling back to conservative whole-HEAD freshness.
classify_file_scope maps non-empty dependency paths to 'paths', empty deps with own scope none to 'none', and every other empty dependency set to 'unscoped'.
build_manifest emits exactly one authenticated 'file-scope: none' line only for none scope, keeping paths and unscoped output byte-identical to the pre-feature contract.
A none declaration present only in an unauthenticated plaintext mirror must not suppress the stale-head verdict.
Flipping scope between none and paths, or changing only no_file_impact_reason, makes the signed record return stale-material via the material fingerprint basis member.
resign_plan_review recovery preserves none scope in its authenticated manifest, while legacy manifests without a file-scope line retain unscoped whole-HEAD semantics.
